column3: BSB reads “took all this to heart and concluded,” where the Hebrew has “gave to my heart, and to make clear”; “what lies ahead” renders “everything is before them.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the one who refuses to take a vow” renders “the one fearing an oath.”
Close to the Hebrew; “they join the dead” supplies a verb for “after it, to the dead.”
BSB reads “there is hope for anyone who is among the living,” following the Qere (“is joined”); “however” is added.
Close to the Hebrew; “bread” renders the Hebrew word for food.
Close to the Hebrew; “never spare the oil” renders “may oil not be lacking.”
BSB renders “see life” as “enjoy life,” “a wife whom you love” as “your beloved wife,” and “futility” as “fleeting”; “God” is supplied as subject of “has given.”
BSB adds “all” to “with your might” and renders “explanation” (reckoning) as “planning.”
BSB renders “I returned and I saw” as “I saw something else”; “bread” renders the word for food, and “the skillful” renders “the knowledgeable.”
Close to the Hebrew; “someone found” is rendered passive (“was found”).
BSB renders “in quietness are heard” as “the calm words … are heeded.”
